findings.title: Template reads the current date or time
findings.detail: Common and usually benign (e.g. Llama 3 inserts today's date into the system prompt).

findings.title: Template adds fixed text the model will read
findings.detail:
Review this text; it is sent to the model with your messages: 
  - "You have access to the following functions. To call a function, please respond with JSON for a function call."
  - "Respond in the format {"name": function name, "parameters": dictionary of argument name and its value}."
  - "Cannot put tools in the first user message when there's no first user message!"
  - "Given the following functions, please respond with a JSON for a function call"
  - "with its proper arguments that best answers the given prompt."
  (+1 more)

findings.title: Matches the official Llama 3.2 template
findings.detail: Identical (ignoring whitespace) to the template in https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (unsloth mirror).
